description.message: Save pages, selections, links and pictures to your Minerva notes.

connectFirst.message: Connect the clipper to your Minerva server first.

cannotClipHere.message: This page can't be clipped. Open a web page and try again.

previewWords.message: About $COUNT$ words, with links and pictures from the page.

noArticle.message: No article found on this page: only its address and description will be saved.

noFolders.message: You can't add notes to any folder on this server.

notConnected.message: The clipper is not connected. Connect it in its settings.

expired.message: The connection to Minerva has ended. Connect again in the settings.

cutShort.message: The rest of the page was too long to clip.

optionsIntro.message: Enter the address of your Minerva server. You'll sign in there and approve the clipper.

connectHint.message: The clipper can only see the names of the folders you can add notes to and add new notes. It can't open, change or delete your notes.

badServer.message: Enter a web address, such as notes.example.com.

permissionRefused.message: The clipper needs permission to reach your server.

connectedHint.message: Clip from the toolbar button, or right-click a page, a selection, a link or a picture. Right-click clips go to the folder you used last.

chooseFolderFirst.message: Choose a folder in the clipper first, then right-click clips go there.
